title: Bug: links show as opened that the recipient never opened
objective: Support ticket from Olivia, a library owner: "I shared the Q3 board deck with board@kestrel.example on Sep 30 and clicked the link once myself to check it worked. Since then the library says the deck was opened, the activity page says board@kestrel opened it, and they never got a reminder. They swear they have not opened it. My teammate Tom says the same happens to him." Find the cause and fix it, with a regression test. Recipients and other visitors opening a link must keep counting exactly as they do now, and the people who shared a document must still be able to open its links.
acceptance: A library member opening a link is not counted as the recipient opening it, on the library page, the activity page or the analytics API
After a member opens it, the recipient is still reminded
A real visitor's open still counts and still stops reminders
Members can still open the link and see the document
plan_summary: openLink stops recording a view when the visitor is a member of the document's library; a regression test.
